profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I'm a software developer with experience in large C/C++ projects for RTOS on embedded systems. I'm excited about cutting edge technology and the opportunity to work closely with smart and ambitious people to solve tough technical problems.

Besides works, I'm also interested in Linux, trading bot, Arduino, machine learning and open source projects.

I'm looking forward to having opportunities to work at North America, Japan, Australia and Europe, leave me a message if you have one to share with me!

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Received recognition of outstanding contributions, vAwards (received in 2016, 2017, 2018) 
3/4/5G Mobile Modem SoC Software Development
Conducted cycle accurate microprocessor simulator for firmware development and performance/architecture/power evaluation (Maintain 20K+ lines of C++)
Reduced 1 man hour per day by introducing continuous integration for SoC simulators.
Helped reduce SRAM usage by 20% by developing scripts and tools to evaluate SoC’s SRAM’s usage on simulators
Developed firmware and functional tests in C for embedded system

projects.title: Deep Discovery Inspector
projects.description:
With 360-degree monitoring of network traffic, Deep Discovery Inspector provides network-wide visibility and intelligence to detect and respond to targeted attacks and advanced threats. Deep Discovery Inspector monitors all ports and more than 80 protocols, giving you the broadest protection available.

Specialized detection engines and custom sandboxing identify and analyze malware, command-and-control (C&C) communications, and evasive attacker activities that are invisible to standard security. In-depth threat intelligence enables a rapid response and is shared automatically with your other security products to create a real-time custom defense against your attackers.
